description: MCP server for Jira Service Management Operations — alerts, on-call schedules and responders
name: io.github.rrvrs/jira-alerts-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Atlassian site cloud id (a UUID). Find it at https://<your-site>.atlassian.net/_edge/tenant_info
environmentVariables.name: JSM_CLOUD_ID

environmentVariables.description: Atlassian account email, for API token auth. Required unless JSM_OAUTH_TOKEN is set.
environmentVariables.name: JSM_EMAIL

environmentVariables.description: Atlassian account API token, paired with JSM_EMAIL. Required unless JSM_OAUTH_TOKEN is set.
environmentVariables.name: JSM_API_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: OAuth 3LO or Forge bearer token. Takes precedence over JSM_EMAIL and JSM_API_TOKEN.
environmentVariables.name: JSM_OAUTH_TOKEN

title: Jira Alerts (JSM Operations)
